basket.instruction: Use the left arm to lift one corner of the towel covering the basket while moving the active camera arm to look inside the basket. Use the right arm to take the corn out of the basket and place it on the table, then use the left arm to cover the basket with the towel.

book.instruction: Use the left arm to pick up the book from the table. Move the active camera arm to scan the bookshelf and find an empty slot, then align the book with that slot using the left arm and insert it.
